tool_args.rationale: The thermal-fin bridge maps to the two-layer inland-hub siphon. The strong monotone saturation across input levels and decrease at higher sink gradient align with its documented form. Fit vmax and inhibition rho numerically; the data do not require a horizon-dependent mechanism.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observations use the same horizon and x/memory states; despite this, the explicit bridge signatures and gradient dependence support a static siphon law over the costlier coupled ODE.

The archive permits an open branch term, but the two gradient-varying observations and existing curve can be explained parsimoniously by the documented baseline two-layer siphon; a signed branch term is not independently identifiable from seven rows.
Not useful for identifying the deterministic transfer law and explicitly excluded by the measurement policy.
